scope: Historical TDG FY2024 10-K, as of 2024-09-30. Frozen before any paid call. Read from the filing's visible text, not from any handoff. This key proves one dated TDG case only.
pass_rule: A chart mark passes when it equals this key for its period, or is a stated gap. A ratio on another stated basis, such as principal debt, is compared with that basis's own inputs and reported, not silently accepted.

total_debt.label: Total debt (carrying; includes issuance costs, discount and premium)

cash_interest.label: Cash paid during the period for interest, net

undrawn.label: Borrowings available under the revolving commitments
undrawn.note: FY2023 availability is not stated in this filing.

S.1.title: Leverage
S.1.basis: Hand-calculated to 2 decimals from stated inputs: total debt / EBITDA As Defined; (total debt - cash) / EBITDA As Defined.

S.2.title: Interest cover
S.2.basis: Hand-calculated to 2 decimals from stated inputs: EBITDA As Defined / cash interest paid.

S.4.title: Debt maturities
S.4.basis: Stated, page 153: future maturities of long-term debt, excluding finance leases.
